Gen Con Indy is proud to announce the following guests: David
Carradine (Kill Bill & Kung Fu), Walter Koenig (Star Trek), Linda
Blair (The Exorcist), Gil Gerard (Buck Rogers in the 25th Century),
and a host of others. Go to
http://www.gencon.com/displayindy.aspx?file=indy-mgoh for more
information.

The Gen Con Indy gaming event schedule is now available for viewing.
Hop online at https://registration.gencon.com, search the database,
and get ready for event ticket sales to open at noon PST on May 7th.

Gen Con So Cal dates are December 2 - 5 at the Anaheim Convention
Center. For more information go to
http://www.gencon.com/socalhome.aspx?file=socal

Gen Con LLC is also proud to announce a new edition to our web site:
Forums. These are message boards for our great convention community.
Go to http://forums.gencon.com

Hope to see you at the Best Four Days in Gaming in August or in
December or both!!
